testCases.title: Every interactive control is wired to a handler and produces a DOM change
testCases.expected: Every button, tab, link-button, select and drop-zone has a bound handler; activating it changes the DOM (state badge, view, validation banner or list). Zero dead controls.

testCases.title: Mutual tab exclusivity & layout switching: 'New application' (new-application) shows its panel and hides all sibling panels
testCases.expected: Clicking tab 'New application' ([data-testid=tab-new-application]) sets aria-selected='true', renders [data-testid=panel-new-application] with a non-zero bounding box, and hides all sibling tab panels ([data-testid=panel-my-applications], [data-testid=panel-fee-calculator], [data-testid=panel-review-queue], [data-testid=panel-buyers], [data-testid=panel-agents]).

testCases.title: Accessibility baseline: labels, names, roles, landmarks, live regions
testCases.expected: Every input has a bound label; icon-only buttons have accessible names; one main landmark and a heading hierarchy exist; status/validation regions use aria-live/role=alert; no positive tabindex.

testCases.expected: Signed in as 'Commercial Buyer' viewing a record in SUBMITTED, no 'Reject' control is rendered (external role — internal controls never appear on external views); a direct attempt is rejected with a user-readable message and no state change.

testCases.title: Role 'Licensing Staff' must not see or use the 'Submit' control
testCases.expected: Signed in as 'Licensing Staff' viewing a record in DRAFT, no 'Submit' control is rendered; a direct attempt is rejected with a user-readable message and no state change.

testCases.title: Default landing persona (Commercial Buyer) entry-to-submit journey without setRole override
testCases.expected: Starting from a fresh goto('ui') without calling setRole, the default landing persona ('Commercial Buyer') sees the initial state ('DRAFT'), steps through any multi-step wizard, clicks 'Submit', and transitions the record to 'SUBMITTED'.

testCases.title: Zero database table/column identifiers in visible UI text
testCases.expected: None of the 55 schema identifiers appears in rendered visible text (attributes such as data-testid are allowed).

testCases.title: Zero raw enum / state / error codes in visible UI text
testCases.expected: No UPPER_SNAKE_CASE state, trigger or error code is rendered; the human label from spec §3.3 is shown instead.

testCases.title: Zero internal UUIDs, primary keys, legacy identifiers or engineering notes in visible UI text
testCases.expected: No UUIDs, raw numeric primary keys labelled as ids, legacy object/file names, 'parity'/'TODO' notes, SQL or API paths are visible.

testCases.title: Zero unmasked sensitive identifiers (PII) in visible UI text
testCases.expected: Sensitive identifiers listed in spec Pillar 2 render only in their masked form.
